reproduction.author_code_status: no confirmed repository found in exact-title searches on 2026-09-28
assumptions: The paper specifies point mass and lag; lag constant and trapezoidal integration follow the predecessor.
Eq9 whole-state exponential Jacobian is distinct from the predecessor partial-diagonal CUDA rule.
Sensor state gradients are detached; the paper does not specify a differentiable ray-casting implementation.
Ten proprioceptive fields, elevation offset, range limits, activation slope, and invalid-ray masking are explicit reconstruction choices.
Undisclosed loss weights, jerk averaging, optimizer defaults, primitive distribution, and speed distribution are explicitly configured.
50000 updates follows the training figure extent and predecessor default, not a text-specified update budget.
Navigation8 uses its 0.07m body radius, task boundaries, and terminal rules; the policy is trained only on independent static primitives.
